Buckingham County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Beginner-Friendly Guide to Property Auctions

Buckingham County, Virginia hosts tax sales to collect unpaid property taxes. These public auctions give buyers a chance to purchase real estate while helping the county recover overdue tax funds. If you’re thinking about getting involved, here’s how it all works in simple terms.

How Tax Sales Work in Buckingham County

The county doesn’t hold tax sales on a regular schedule. Instead, they schedule auctions when enough properties qualify due to unpaid taxes.

  • Auction Type: Public tax foreclosure sales
  • Purpose: Recover delinquent property taxes
  • Auction Calendar: Watch for updates from the county or check the auction listings online

Everything You Need to Know About the Sale

Before you place a bid, it’s important to know the process—from registration to final payment.

  • Where the Auction Happens: Most sales are held in person at a county-announced location
  • Auction Timing: Times vary; auction announcements will list the exact start time (usually Eastern Time)
  • Registration Requirements:
    • You must register in advance
    • Each auction notice includes step-by-step registration details
  • Redemption Period Rules:
    • Property owners can pay their debt and stop the sale anytime before auction day
    • Once the auction happens, they lose the right to redeem
  • How Bidding and Payments Work:
    1. The highest bidder wins the property
    2. A deposit is required—amount varies per auction and is listed in the terms
    3. Accepted payment methods: check or money order (no cash)
    4. The final balance must be paid by the deadline in the auction notice

Where to Stay Updated on Tax Sales

To stay informed, check these official sources:

  • Buckingham County Treasurer’s Office Website – They post upcoming auction details
  • Auction Notices – These include everything from sale time to payment terms

Who to Contact for Help or Questions

If you need support or more details, get in touch with:

  • Buckingham County Treasurer’s Office
  • Email: cchristian@buckinghamcounty.virginia.gov
  • Phone: (434) 969-4744
  • Address: P.O. Box 106, 13360 West James Anderson Highway, Buckingham, VA 23921

Smart Tips for Auction Day

Make sure you’re ready by following these practical tips:

  • Look out for large tracts that have been divided—there may be access challenges.
  • Many homes here were built before code enforcement was standard; get inspections.
  • Don’t forget to ask about hunting or timber use if bidding on land.
